GP2X / Wiz / Caanoo firmware redistribution
===========================================

The game runtime magiceyes stages into its release bundle includes shared libraries
that originate in the Game Park Holdings (GPH) device firmware (the real libSDL and the
SDL_image/_ttf/_mixer helpers, the glibc-2.3.6 C runtime, and assorted decoder libs).

GPH distributed the GP2X / Wiz / Caanoo firmware freely to anyone who requested it, and
the firmware images remain freely available. The shared libraries it contains are open
source: SDL 1.2 and the SDL_* helpers are LGPL (see SDL-LGPL.txt); glibc is LGPL; the
GPH SDK material is under a permissive zlib-style license (see GPH-SDK-license.txt).

magiceyes ships these libraries only as the runtime needed to RUN games; it does not
redistribute the proprietary firmware UI (gp2xmenu, themes, fonts, bundled apps). Booting
the firmware menu itself requires the user to supply their own firmware image.
